key_facts: July 16 UPDATE (local Al Jazeera audit through July 16; 16 clear deadliest-strike days June 24-July 16): On Thursday July 16, Al Jazeera reported at least 5 Palestinians killed across Gaza, with the DEADLIEST single Israeli strike hitting near the northern neighbourhood of Tuffah in Gaza City (killing 2). Other July 16 strikes killed 1 in a western Gaza City tent encampment, 1 by tank fire in eastern Gaza City, and 1 in a car strike in Khan Younis (plus AJ photo coverage of earlier strikes destroying homes in Nuseirat). Updated 16-day empirical audit (June 24-July 16): Gaza City 5.3/16 (33.1%, including 4 of 5 deaths and the deadliest strike on July 16), Khan Younis / al-Mawasi 5.3/16 (33.1%), Deir el-Balah 2/16 (12.5%, Jun 29 & Jul 15), Jabalia 1/16 (6.3%, Jul 14 police station killing 8), Maghazi 1/16, Beit Lahiya 1/16. Bayesian Dirichlet update for tomorrow's resolution day (July 17): bumped Gaza City 0.32->0.34, trimmed Khan Younis 0.30->0.29, kept Deir el-Balah 0.11, Jabalia 0.08, al-Mawasi 0.07 (sum 0.89; 0.11 outside for Nuseirat/Maghazi/Beit Lahiya/Bureij/Rafah).
